Nonprofit & Community

Kindred Harbor

Demonstration website · Fictional brand

Neighbors helping neighbors, every season.

A complete six-page demonstration website for a fictional coastal nonprofit: a warm, welcoming design that makes volunteering the clearest next step and keeps every figure honestly labelled as illustrative.

Design highlights

  • Home, Programs, Volunteer, Donate, About and Credits pages
  • Volunteer sign-up with accessible validation and an error summary (demonstration: nothing is sent or stored)
  • Illustrative impact figures and a seasonal drive, each marked as sample data
  • Verified CC0 coastal and garden photography, credited on every use

Palette

  • Warm cream #fbf6ee
  • Harbor teal #1f4e5a
  • Coral #e8674a
  • Lantern gold #e9b44c

Typography: Fraunces headings with DM Sans for text and navigation

Photography & Portfolio

Vale & Ember

Demonstration website · Fictional brand

Light, found in quiet places.

A complete five-page demonstration website for a fictional photography studio: a dark, cinematic design where the photographs lead. All images are credited CC0 samples by other photographers, not work by the studio.

Design highlights

  • Home, Portfolio, Studio, Booking and Credits pages
  • Slow cross-fading hero with a pause control and a still version for reduced motion
  • Filterable portfolio with a keyboard-friendly lightbox
  • Booking inquiry form (demonstration: nothing is sent, booked or stored)

Palette

  • Charcoal #0b0c10
  • Ivory #efe9df
  • Ember #e09257
  • Bronze #b8875a

Typography: Cormorant Garamond headings with Manrope for navigation and controls
